set.body: Phase 1 review finding 5 of 8. R/result.R query_geometry() materializes packed geometry from a block store before checking whether the query dimension matches the stored geometry. Invalid requests can therefore perform a full store read before failing. Validate query type, shape, symmetry or operator contract, and dimension against result metadata before the first read. Preserve blockwise evaluation for valid block-backed results rather than requiring full materialization. Done when a read-counting store proves zero reads for every invalid query and valid direct evaluation agrees with the full-geometry oracle.
set.title: Reject incompatible queries before geometry-store I/O
